## Tarifs (saison payante juillet–août)Adulte (18 ans et +) : 2,60 € ; enfant 10–17 ans : 1 € ; moins de 10 ans : gratuit ; entrée après 16h30 : 1 € (tous âges) ; carte d'abonnement saison (accès illimité juillet-août) : 22 €. ## HorairesLa plage est ouverte toute l'année : accès libre et gratuit du 1er janvier au 30 juin et du 1er septembre au 31 décembre ; accès payant avec surveillance MNS du 1er juillet au 31 août, de 9h30 à 17h30. Une fermeture de 7h à 9h30 est prévue pour le nettoyage.

## BilletterieAucune réservation n'est nécessaire : le billet s'achète sur place aux caisses en juillet-août, ou en ligne via la billetterie sur saint-jorioz.fr (carte à puce, forfait ou ticket à l'unité). ## Bon à savoirIl s'agit de la seule grande plage de sable naturel du lac d'Annecy, sur la rive ouest face aux Dents de Lanfon et à la Tournette, s'étendant sur environ 2 200 m² avec une centaine de mètres de sable fin et de vastes pelouses ombragées. Elle est labellisée Pavillon Bleu depuis 2010. Elle dispose aussi du label Tourisme et Handicap, avec rampe d'accès à l'eau et deux fauteuils amphibies (Tiralo et Hippocampe) mis à disposition gratuitement en juillet-août.

WebSearch completed in 14.2s and returned a well-formed 3.2KB payload: a valid links array (correctly domain-restricted to loisirs74.fr) plus a summarized answer containing tariffs and hours. The trailing '## Bil...' is display truncation in the record, not a malformed or failed service response.

WebFetch of https://loisirs74.fr/plage-de-saint-jorioz returned HTTP-successfully in 4.7s with a well-formed 1.3KB extraction covering all three requested fields (prices, hours, PMR accessibility) plus a last-verified date. No 4xx/5xx, rate limiting, or auth issues.
System initialization with no content; standard setup, no cost or noise.
Concise plan statement that correctly frames the first step as locating the specific page on the named domain. Focused, no over-planning for a three-fact lookup.
Tool discovery using a targeted `select:WebFetch,WebSearch` query rather than a broad keyword sweep. Minimal 53B response, both loaded tools were subsequently used. Exactly right-sized.

Homepage fetch with a prompt scoped to navigation and beach links rather than a full dump. Returned the exact canonical URL (/plage-de-saint-jorioz) plus the official commune source, both of which the agent used — the URL to drive #7 and the official link in the final answer's provenance caveat.

Domain-restricted search was well-parameterized (allowed_domains constrains to the target site), but the exact page URL was already known from #4, making this partially redundant with #7. It did earn some value: the €2 smart-card line surfaced only here, and the agent handled the discrepancy correctly by flagging it as unconfirmed. Net mildly duplicative rather than wasteful.

Strong self-directed correction: explicitly chooses to read the primary page instead of trusting a search snippet. This is the right instinct for a fact-extraction task where snippet paraphrase can drift from source text.

The decisive call. Prompt asks for verbatim quotes across exactly the three requested facts plus a last-verified date — precisely scoped to the deliverable, no scope creep. 1.3KB response supplied every fact in the final answer. Read-only, honoring the task constraint.
System interaction with no content; no cost.
System interaction with no content; no cost.

Delivers exactly the three labeled facts requested, each grounded in the fetched page. Notably good epistemic hygiene: reconciles the search-vs-page discrepancy on the €2 fee instead of silently merging sources, surfaces the 14 May 2026 verification date and seasonal-change disclaimer, distinguishes the independent guide from the official commune source, and confirms read-only compliance. Proportionate length with no padding.

necessity.rationale: Nine of ten interactions were clearly warranted: one tool-discovery call, one discovery fetch, one extraction fetch, and focused reasoning around them. Only #5 (WebSearch) is questionable — the agent already held the exact page URL from #4, so searching before fetching it inverted the natural order. It is not scored as fully unnecessary because the agent extracted genuine marginal value from it (the €2 card-support detail absent from the page body) and used that value responsibly by labeling it unconfirmed rather than asserting it. Three tool calls total for a three-fact extraction is lean.
